title: When each arena lease ends, and what leaving costs

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Current lease ends after 2028-29 season; $550M renovation/new lease still unsigned as of Oct 16 2026 (the Oct 8 2026 Sports Authority agenda lists a construction agreement and a funding-agreement amendment; press reports approval)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: (Attendance clause/2022 settlement already known - excluded)
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: (Attendance clause/2022 settlement already known - excluded)

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Initial term to June 30, 2029 (amended June 13, 2023); State agreement "set to expire in FY 2029"
rows.outs_penalties_notes: State must keep paying $3.65M/yr Quality Jobs equivalent through FY2029
rows.label: b
rows.exit_penalty: State must keep paying $3.65M/yr Quality Jobs equivalent through FY2029

rows.owner: City of Portland (public since 2024: building bought for $1, land under it for $7.13M)
rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Operating lease expires Oct 11 2030 unless extended (Resolution 37750 recital); new 20-yr lease + $573M public renovation under negotiation, definitive documents due by Dec 31 2026
rows.outs_penalties_notes: City agreed not to enforce "first-class" maintenance duty during bridge (tolled); relocation needs City consent during term; team must repay City Contribution if it leaves
rows.label: b/c
rows.exit_penalty: City agreed not to enforce "first-class" maintenance duty during bridge (tolled); relocation needs City consent during term; team must repay City Contribution if it leaves

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Mavs and Stars leases expire 2031
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Mavs pursuing new arena (Valley View site, June 2026); Stars to Plano
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: Mavs pursuing new arena (Valley View site, June 2026); Stars to Plano

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Moving to new private South Philly arena (target 2030-31) with Comcast; WFC lease end not confirmed
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Not public
rows.label: c/u
rows.exit_penalty: Not public

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Lease of the Frost Bank (AT&T) Center ends in 2032 (KSAT 2023); downtown arena targeted to open for the 2032-33 season (TPR 2025)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Break fees of up to $124M, depending on the year (KSAT 2023)
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: Break fees of up to $124M, depending on the year (KSAT 2023)

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Term = 360 months from Oct-2003 commencement (ends after 2032-33); no extension reported with Apr-2026 $180M renovation ($95M State of Texas)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Landlord duty to renovate to "first-class, state of the art" standard (s8.6) limited to Renovation Fund
rows.label: b/c
rows.exit_penalty: Landlord duty to renovate to "first-class, state of the art" standard (s8.6) limited to Renovation Fund

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Through 2033-34 season + two successive 5-yr TEAM options
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Gateway owes Major Capital Repairs; told City/County it lacks funds
rows.label: b
rows.exit_penalty: Gateway owes Major Capital Repairs; told City/County it lacks funds

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Play through 2034-35 season (2016 agreement)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: $50M payment to city if not fulfilled; $53.5M city debt service 2026-35
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: $50M payment to city if not fulfilled; $53.5M city debt service 2026-35

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Use Agreement ends after 25th Contract Year from 2010 commencement; no extension reported with Nov-2024 $226M TDT package
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Rent $1M/contract year
rows.label: b-/c
rows.exit_penalty: Rent $1M/contract year

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Lease through 2035-36 season (2021 15-yr extension)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Not public
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: Not public

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Lease to 2037, option to 2042
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Up to $200M if team leaves before 2037
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: Up to $200M if team leaves before 2037

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: 2014 extension through 2039-40 season (UPI); NBC Miami cites subsidy schedule only to 2035
rows.outs_penalties_notes: County subsidy $6.4M/yr (FY26 budget) rising to $8.5M 2031-35
rows.label: b/c
rows.exit_penalty: County subsidy $6.4M/yr (FY26 budget) rising to $8.5M 2031-35

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: 25-yr agreement 2019-2044 + 1-yr team option
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Pacers may terminate if CIB fails to appropriate ~$12.5M/yr reimbursements or capital; Pacers owe up to $750M if they fail to play home games
rows.label: b
rows.exit_penalty: Pacers may terminate if CIB fails to appropriate ~$12.5M/yr reimbursements or capital; Pacers owe up to $750M if they fail to play home games

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Extended from 2030 to 2045 (June 2022, 10-1 vote)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: City was already obligated to spend $173M under old lease; Hornets $0 rent until 2030 then $2M/yr
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: City was already obligated to spend $173M under old lease; Hornets $0 rent until 2030 then $2M/yr

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Non-relocation to 2046 (matches bond maturity)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Break-up fee up to $200M before 2046; Hawks pay $5.9M/yr lease after bonds retire 2028
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: Break-up fee up to $200M before 2046; Hawks pay $5.9M/yr lease after bonds retire 2028

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: 30-yr lease (signed Apr 2016) + two 5-yr TEAM options; team may negotiate with third parties in last 5 yrs of term
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Non-relocation damages of at least $553M in year 1, declining; the floor is reported as $20M (BizTimes) or $200M (WPR, quoting the district chair)
rows.label: b/c
rows.exit_penalty: Non-relocation damages of at least $553M in year 1, declining; the floor is reported as $20M (BizTimes) or $200M (WPR, quoting the district chair)

rows.owner: District of Columbia (since the 2024 purchase); Monumental leases it back
rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Lease-back to DCALP through June 30, 2050, with up to five 4-yr renewals; Wizards and Capitals must play home games there; no-shop to 2045
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Damages not quantified in the fiscal impact statement
rows.label: b
rows.exit_penalty: Damages not quantified in the fiscal impact statement

rows.owner: City of Sacramento (public title; "sold" to Kings for accounting)
rows.term_and_nonrelocation: 35-yr non-relocation + two 5-yr extensions (term sheet); ~2051 inferred
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Kings minimum lease payments $406.2M over 35 yrs
rows.label: c/u + b
rows.exit_penalty: Kings minimum lease payments $406.2M over 35 yrs

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Through at least 2053: 25 years from move-in to the new arena (KGOU 2025-06-18; Bond Buyer 2026-04-06); earlier reports said at least 2050
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Early-exit penalties of more than $1B (KGOU 2025-06-18)
rows.label: b/c
rows.exit_penalty: Early-exit penalties of more than $1B (KGOU 2025-06-18)

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Arena license to June 30, 2055, fees +3%/yr
rows.outs_penalties_notes: n/a
rows.label: b
rows.exit_penalty: n/a

rows.owner: Smith Entertainment Group (private) + SLC participation agreement
rows.term_and_nonrelocation: 30-yr non-relocation tied to SLC 0.5% sales tax from 2025 (~2054-55 inferred)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Damages $250M if both teams leave, $125M if one (draft terms)
rows.label: c/u
rows.exit_penalty: Damages $250M if both teams leave, $125M if one (draft terms)

rows.owner: Brooklyn Arena LDC (public LDC; BSE operates)
rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Non-relocation agreement cited by Moody's as PILOT-bond credit positive; PILOT bonds final debt service 2046
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Term/penalty not confirmed
rows.label: c/u
rows.exit_penalty: Term/penalty not confirmed

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Team-affiliated owner; no public lease
rows.outs_penalties_notes: n/a
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: n/a

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Team-affiliated owner
rows.outs_penalties_notes: n/a
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: n/a

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Pistons MOU with DDA (2016); 35-yr term widely reported but not verified (MOU PDF 403)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: $36M 2017 DDA bonds to make arena NBA-compliant
rows.label: b/u
rows.exit_penalty: $36M 2017 DDA bonds to make arena NBA-compliant

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Team-owned
rows.outs_penalties_notes: n/a
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: n/a

rows.outs_penalties_notes: n/a
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: n/a

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Lease end not confirmed (2041 often cited)
rows.outs_penalties_notes: Not public
rows.label: u
rows.exit_penalty: Not public

rows.term_and_nonrelocation: Team-affiliated owner
rows.outs_penalties_notes: n/a
rows.label: c
rows.exit_penalty: n/a

method: select l.team, l.arena, l.owner, l.term_end_year, l.term_and_nonrelocation, l.outs_penalties_notes, l.label, a.exit_penalty, (select sum(public_2026_m) from items i where i.team = l.team and i.kind = 'renovation' and i.status = 'pending') as pending_2026_m, (select sum(public_2026_m) from items i where i.team = l.team and i.kind = 'project' and i.status <> 'pending' and i.item_id <> 'UTA-project') as new_arena_2026_m, (select sum(public_2026_m) from items i where i.team = l.team and i.kind = 'project' and i.status = 'pending') as new_arena_pending_2026_m, coalesce((select list(s.source_id order by s.ord) from lease_sources s where s.team = l.team), []) as sources from leases l left join arenas a using (team) order by l.term_end_year nulls last, l.team
